says: Only one file is required: `plugin-name/.plugin/plugin.json` or `plugin-name/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
Hook commands have access to these environment variables: `$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR` ... `$OPENHANDS_TOOL_NAME`
sources.silent_on: a plugin-root variable for hook commands

says: Note that the plugin metadata, i.e., `plugin-name/.plugin/plugin.json`, is required.
hook commands run with shell=True and cwd=self.working_dir; the environment adds OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR, OPENHANDS_SESSION_ID, OPENHANDS_EVENT_TYPE and OPENHANDS_TOOL_NAME, no plugin root
exit code ``1`` does **not** block -- only ``2`` does
